regime_context: The detector shows a broad, two-tier precious-metals-led regime for the TSX: Gold Miners and Silver & Royalties sit clearly on top with the highest momentum scores and durability bars, while nearly all defensive/interest-sensitive groups (Telecom, REITs, Consumer Staples, Utilities) are ineligible with deeply negative scores. The rotation read is broad but not directional, absorption is low, and no theme is crowded — this is a clean, un-crowded metals leadership backdrop, not a one-narrative squeeze.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Base Metals & Copper (rank 3, score 1.308, eligible) can recover its 'mean-revert' hurst_tag and weak breadth (0.667) into a durable trend-and-breadth profile like the metals leaders — the watch retires if its durability_bar falls below 0.50 or breadth drops under 0.6 while Gold Miners holds above 0.9 breadth.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners sit at rank 1 with the highest score (1.8), the strongest durability bar (0.66), and the best breadth (0.933) of the entire board — leadership that is broad-based within the theme, not a one-stock spike. The absolute-trend gate is eligible and, per backtest_verdict, is the one validated risk-control leg; exposure here carries the staying-power benefit of that gate without a crowded flag to cap it.
evidence: breadth 0.933 — strongest participation among all 16 themes
theses.dissent: cross-sectional momentum has rank-IC ~0 — the top rank is an attention lens, not alpha — and gold's r10 (-0.0054) is slightly negative, so leadership could stall without warning; the macro backdrop is dominated by unscheduled geopolitical headlines (unscheduled_share 1.0), which can reverse a gold bid abruptly.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX composite by 5% before October 23, 2026

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the confirmed challenger at rank 2 (score 1.627) with the second-highest durability (0.63) and strong breadth (0.917), tracking the same precious-metals leadership as Gold Miners. It is uncrowded. However, sharing an ETF proxy (XGD.TO) with Gold Miners means this is a highly correlated call rather than an independent diversification.
evidence: rotation challenger margin only 0.173 from leader
theses.dissent: It is not distinguishable in tradable form from Gold Miners (same XGD.TO proxy), so any additional lean here is effectively double-counting one theme; silver-specific beta can be more volatile than gold and the hurst_tag is only 'mixed', giving no persistence edge.

falsifier.text: Silver & Royalties (via XGD.TO) lags Gold Miners by 3% over any 10-session window before late October 2026

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the stand-out among non-materials themes: rank 5, eligible, the only theme with a clean 'trend' hurst_tag and a durability bar (0.66) matching the metals leaders. In a market where the absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control, a durable, trend-tagged, uncrowded financials theme offers a different (and lower-volatility) way to stay exposed through the same discipline.
evidence: hurst_tag 'trend' — only trend-tagged theme near the top
theses.dissent: score is only 0.75 versus 1.8 for Gold Miners — it is distant from the actual leadership concentration; breadth is weak at 0.429, and the track_record shows dir_accuracy only 0.372, so direction calls on second-tier themes have a poor history.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO closes below its 50-day moving average for five consecutive sessions before October 26, 2026

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
